stability: Anything not listed here — everything under _plan/ — is internal and may change without notice. PSA makes no model calls: there are no inference runs to join; provenance is the manifest's input pointers.

structure.description: CPL-style markers, graded break candidates, and (narrative mode) evidence-graded sequences. acts[] is deliberately ABSENT on masters — a measured negative result: broadcast act positions are delivery metadata, not surface signal (README.md §8).
structure.notes: break_candidates are PROSPECTIVE (where a break could cleanly go — the ad-break posture), never a claim about where a network historically broke. Sequences carry a via on every join (music_bridge = a cue that STARTED in the earlier scene; setting; recurrence; cast; micro_scene) and may be ignored by consumers — over-chaining on densely-scored serialized drama is a known, recorded limit gated on a chapters ground truth.

rundown.description: NEWS MODE ONLY: the industrialized rundown — CA's discourse stories joined to the video with role-resolved boundaries, plus per-shot roles
rundown.notes: Three start times per story, consumers choose: start_sec (editorial — the director's cut, START SNAP <=6 s), content_start_sec (first story-role shot: 'the actual conversation begins'), speech_start_sec (first word). Interstitials (tease/promo/headlines_block/handoff_banter) are FIRST-CLASS rows — a tease shares its story's slug (identity) but identity never merges spans. Cueless video between items is assigned by VISUAL ROLE, never adjacency (the measured promo-absorption defect class). Requires the CA default_news variant and enrichment default_news fields upstream.

manifest.description: Mode + mode evidence + input pointers + product locations
manifest.notes: PSA is free to recompute: no spend, deterministic over its inputs — a policy change downstream is a re-derive over these products, never a re-run of Layer-1.
